data.name: Muv-Luv: Tactics Kalidasa at Nightmare
data.detailed_description:
The heir to the legendary "Muv-Luv" series, "Muv-Luv: Tactics Kalidasa at Nightmare" is a tactical simulation RPG devoted to pure gameplay excellence.

1) The encroaching BETA threat, and the overwhelming despair it brings

Feel the visceral terror of being crushed, body and mind.

At the core of this game lies all-out combat against humanity's greatest foe, the BETA. As a UN Forces squadron commander, you stand against the vast horde of an invading extraterrestrial species. On the front line, where death is always one breath away, the tension and exhilaration of piloting a Tactical Surface Fighter await you. Intense combat will etch the despair and fervor unique to the Muv-Luv universe deep into your psyche.

2) A deep story and world for everyone to get immersed in

No prior series knowledge is required—deeper insight for the initiated; revelation for the newcomers.

The rich world of Muv-Luv has long enthralled its fans, yet for newcomers, it may have seemed a steep wall to climb. MuvTac constructs a self-contained story that seamlessly blends military, SF, and interpersonal drama under extreme circumstances. Even players with no prior Muv-Luv experience can step in without hesitation. Anyone can become the protagonist of this epic thanks to thoughtful, dramatic storytelling.

3) Refined strategy, where a single move decides life and death

Reach the pinnacle of thought through single-player-only gameplay.

Online elements have been stripped away, leaving a razor-sharp strategic experience.

Turn-based Battles: Unit placement and strategic decision-making determine your fate in this combat system focused on careful deliberation.

Deepening Progression: Recruit Eishi (TSF pilots), choose your loadout, and customize your Tactical Surface Fighters.

The Commander's Burden: Every choice you make can determine your subordinates' fates and the success or failure of your mission.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel i5 7600 / AMD Ryzen 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 5500 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 30 GB available space

  • OS: Windows10/11 64-bit

  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060/AMD Radeon RX 5700XT/intel ARC A750
  • DirectX: Version 12
